name: Approve a reviewed inquiry and send the single-use admission-form invite
priorityReason: The only route to the admission form. Nothing downstream happens without this approval.

goal.capability: to decide on a reviewed inquiry and, on approval, let the family into the admission form
goal.outcome: only families the school has agreed to consider ever see the admission form

additional.description: An inquiry is forwarded by the School Admin and enters the approval queue.
An issued invite reaches its expiry date and is invalidated (BR-5).
An approved inquiry whose invite is unused after the configured period is surfaced for follow-up (BR-8).

preconditions.condition: The inquiry is at status Forwarded to Principal.
The acting user is Principal or Director.
A WhatsApp channel is configured with balance, and the invite template exists.

postConditions: The inquiry carries a recorded decision: approved or rejected, by whom, when, and on what reason where rejected.
On approval a single-use invite exists, tied to that inquiry, with an expiry date, and it is the only route to the admission form.
The send is logged against the inquiry with its date, channel and delivery status, so the school knows whether the family actually received it.
On rejection the inquiry is closed with the reason recorded, and the family is informed.
The family can be followed up where the invite was delivered but never used.
No admission form has been completed and no student record exists. Approval opens a door; it admits nobody.

businessRules.rule: No family reaches the admission form without an invite issued here. The admission form has no public address.
Only the Principal or Director may approve or reject. The School Admin's forwarding is a recommendation, not a decision.
Rejection requires a reason. The family is told why, so an unexplained rejection is not permitted.
The invite is single-use and tied to one inquiry. Once the admission form is submitted the link stops working, so it cannot be forwarded to another family.
An invite expires after the configured period. An expired link is refused with an explanation and can be reissued by the School Admin.
The invite is sent by WhatsApp to the number entered on the inquiry form, and to no other number. Changing the destination number is a correction to the inquiry, recorded as such.
The invite may be resent from the inquiry where the family did not receive it. Each send is logged with its date, channel and delivery status, and resending does not create a second link.
An approved inquiry whose invite is delivered but unused after the configured period is surfaced for follow-up. Approval that leads nowhere is a lost family, not a closed one.
Approving into a class other than the one the family asked for is permitted and is recorded, because the family will be told a different class from the one they requested.
Approval creates no student record and no fee record. It creates an invite and nothing else.

transitions.condition: Approved and the invite is issued.

basicFlow.navigation: Login → Inquiry / Admission → Inquiries awaiting approval
basicFlow.userAction: Opens the inquiry forwarded by the School Admin.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Shows the inquiry with the reviewer's notes and any duplicate or re-admission flag.

basicFlow.userAction: Approves the inquiry, changing the class where a different one is being offered.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Records the decision, the decider and the date, and sets the inquiry to Approved.
Generates a single-use invite link tied to that inquiry, with its expiry date.
Sends the link by WhatsApp to the number entered on the inquiry form.
Logs the send against the inquiry with its date, channel and delivery status, and updates the status as the provider reports it.

basicFlow.userAction: Resends the invite where the family says they did not receive it.
basicFlow.systemResponse: Sends the same link again, increments the resend count and logs the send. No second link is created.

alternateFlows.behaviour: The reason is recorded, the inquiry is closed, and the family is informed. No invite is generated (BR-3).

alternateFlows.condition: The Principal approves into a different class from the one requested
alternateFlows.behaviour: The approved class is recorded alongside the requested one, because the family will be told a class they did not ask for (BR-9).

alternateFlows.navigation: Invite management → Extend expiry, or issue a fresh invite
alternateFlows.behaviour: The expired link is dead. The admin extends the expiry or issues a fresh invite for the same inquiry; the approval itself stands (BR-5).

alternateFlows.condition: The invite is delivered but unused past the follow-up period
alternateFlows.navigation: Login → Inquiry / Admission → Approved, invite unused
alternateFlows.behaviour: The inquiry is surfaced for follow-up so the family is chased rather than quietly lost (BR-8).

alternateFlows.condition: The number on the inquiry form is wrong
alternateFlows.navigation: Inquiry review → Correct contact number → Invite management → Resend
alternateFlows.behaviour: The number is corrected on the inquiry, with the previous value retained, and the invite is resent to the corrected number (BR-6).

conventionsApplied.name: session-and-authentication
conventionsApplied.rule: Every use case except the login use case assumes an authenticated session. Sign out is available on every screen. An expired or invalid session returns the user to the login screen with the message "Your session has ended. Please sign in again."

conventionsApplied.name: role-based-access
conventionsApplied.rule: Access is enforced server-side on every request, not only by hiding menu items. A request for a record outside the actor's permitted scope returns a 403 and the message "You do not have permission to view this record." A use case states additions and restrictions only.

conventionsApplied.name: branch-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every record carries a branch ID. Users see only their own branch unless the use case states otherwise. Super Admin, School Admin and Principal may switch branch from the header.

conventionsApplied.name: academic-session-scope
conventionsApplied.rule: Every academic record carries an academic session ID. Lists default to the current open session.

conventionsApplied.name: list-screens
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list supports search, column sort and page-size selection. Default page size 25; default sort is most recent first. Filters are applied before printing or exporting.

conventionsApplied.name: audit-trail
conventionsApplied.rule: Every create, update, deactivation, approval and reversal writes to the audit log: actor, role, timestamp, record type, record ID, before and after values, and IP address. Audit entries are never editable.

conventionsApplied.name: validation-and-messages
conventionsApplied.rule: Field-level errors appear inline beneath the field on blur and on submit. Errors that block the whole action appear as a banner at the top of the form. Successful actions show a toast. No action succeeds silently.

conventionsApplied.name: dates-times-numbers
conventionsApplied.rule: Dates display as DD-MM-YYYY; date and time as DD-MM-YYYY HH:mm in 24-hour form. Times are school-local. Phone numbers are stored in the registered mobile format.

conventionsApplied.name: language
conventionsApplied.rule: All user-visible strings come from a resource file. No hard-coded text in any screen.

conventionsApplied.name: screen-states
conventionsApplied.rule: Every list, dashboard tile and report defines four states: loading, empty, error and populated. The empty state names what is missing and links to the action that creates it.

conventionsApplied.name: notifications
conventionsApplied.rule: All outbound SMS, WhatsApp, email and push messages are sent through the Messaging module, recorded in the sent-message log with per-channel delivery status, and use a named template. Use cases reference the template; they do not embed message text.

conventionsApplied.name: default-performance-and-retention
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise: a screen loads within 2 seconds and a save completes within 2 seconds at 200 concurrent users; lists paginate above 100 rows; financial and student records are retained 7 years; audit and message logs 12 months; every screen is usable at a 360 px viewport. Fill the non-functional field only to depart from this.

conventionsApplied.name: default-trigger
conventionsApplied.rule: Unless a use case states otherwise, the trigger is: the user navigates to the screen and initiates the action. Fill the Triggers field only where a scheduled job, an event in another module, or an inbound external call also starts it.
